categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in electric vehicle (EV) technology research and development, complete vehicle and component manufacturing, and sales services. Its business includes passenger cars, commercial vehicles (notably electric buses), and technical services. Key products include the electric bus Model T, passenger cars Model C, B, D, E, and the medium-sized bus Model U, with a focus on modular, customizable EV platforms.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced modular EV platforms, a highly integrated Electrical/Electronic Architecture (EEA), and software-defined vehicle technologies including OTA updates. It emphasizes vertical integration of hardware and software, thermal management systems, and motion control platforms. Production follows a light-asset model outsourcing manufacturing to selected contract manufacturers, focusing on design, R&D, and supply chain management.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers include domestic and international EV brands and public transportation operators. The company serves the Taiwanese market predominantly, with expanding presence in North America and Southeast Asia. It targets both passenger vehicle consumers and commercial fleet operators, including public bus companies benefiting from government subsidies and electrification policies.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations and sales are mainly concentrated in Taiwan, with growing activities in North America and Southeast Asia. The company has established subsidiaries in China (Hangzhou) and the United States to support procurement, quality control, design, and sales. It plans to expand global market share by leveraging its CDMS business model and regional manufacturing capabilities.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the EV supply chain. It focuses on vehicle design, integration, and assembly management, acting as a Tier 0.5 integrator by coordinating suppliers and contract manufacturers. It sources key components like battery modules from leading suppliers and manages supply chain relationships to optimize cost and quality.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing modular EV platforms, enhancing EEA and software-defined vehicle capabilities, and expanding CDMS services to multiple brands. R&D focuses on hardware-software vertical integration, thermal management, autonomous driving support, and lightweight design. The company invests heavily in new model development (Models B, C, D, U) and infrastructure expansion such as a new factory in Kaohsiung.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through sales of complete electric vehicles (passenger and commercial) and technical services related to vehicle design and manufacturing. The company also earns income from contract design and manufacturing services (CDMS) for multiple brand customers. It does not rely on licensing or subscription models but on product sales and associated service contracts.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Competitors include global EV manufacturers such as Tesla, GM, Volkswagen, BYD, NIO, XPeng, and Magna. The company differentiates itself with modular platform flexibility, advanced integrated EEA architecture, and a collaborative open platform approach. It positions itself as a comprehensive EV design and manufacturing partner, especially for brands transitioning to electrification, rather than a direct vehicle brand competitor.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company experienced rapid revenue growth, with 2024 consolidated revenue reaching approximately NT$8.52 billion, a 716% increase from the previous year. Despite net losses due to ongoing R&D and expansion investments, it maintains a solid financial structure supported by capital increases and bank financing. The workforce and R&D spending have grown steadily, reflecting an aggressive growth and development trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes an open, shared modular EV platform that reduces development costs and time, enabling flexible, customizable vehicle designs for diverse customer needs. Its advanced EEA architecture and software-defined vehicle capabilities provide competitive advantages in integration, safety, and user experience. The light-asset business model allows agile manufacturing partnerships and localized production, supporting global market expansion and sustainability goals.
